Container.Name: journali-advisor
Container.Overview: The service of a journali product advisor: the chat window for a website and MCP for AI agents. It asks journali through its API with the token of the advisor and needs no database of its own. Runs from the journali image; set up the advisor in journali first (Export, Product advisor) and issue a token there.
Container.Requires: journali: the app whose advisor this service answers, with the same repository

Config.Name: Service
Config.Description: Port of the service; the reverse proxy forwards the public address here

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: What the advisor learns (lernen.json) and optionally the token as a file

Config.Name: JOURNALI
Config.Description: Address of journali as this container reaches it: the address of the Unraid server in the network and the port of the app journali

Config.Name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR
Config.Description: Key of the advisor in journali

Config.Name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN
Config.Description: Token of the advisor (ja_...); empty if JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN_FILE is set

Config.Name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN_FILE
Config.Description: Instead of the field: path of a file with the token, e.g. /daten/token

Config.Name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_DATA
Config.Description: Directory for what the advisor learns, matching the path Data; empty: memory only

Config.Name: JOURNALI_PROXY
Config.Description: 1 behind a reverse proxy: the visitor address comes from X-Forwarded-For; otherwise all visitors count as one
